## 改動 (T28.3)

- `_rewrite_at_mentions_for_discord(body, tm_config)` 加 user_id priority
- Priority 1: `tm_config.discord_user_mentions[name]` → `<@user_id>` (真 Discord ping)
- Priority 2 (fallback): identities.json display_name → `@display_name` (visual @ 不 ping, agent 之間用)
- Priority 3: 保留原樣

`notify_config.json` tavern_mirror 加 discord_user_mentions:
- Tim → 383604378185105408
- David → 191938341137022976

|---|---|
| @Tim test | `<@383604378185105408> test` ✅ |
| @David thanks | `<@191938341137022976> thanks` ✅ |

- Persona @ID 暫保留原樣 (waiting role-based 之後 ship)

- Persona role mapping: Tim Discord server 建 @basecamp-role 等 + 加 `discord_role_mentions` config → `<@&role_id>` mention
